notes:
User wants automatic cloud backups for important working files. After reviewing options, they chose Backblaze, citing file versioning support. They have not stated that Backblaze has been fully configured yet; if helping further, confirm installation, selected files, automatic schedule, exclusions, restore/versioning access, notifications, and storage usage. The 3-2-1 principle remains useful: ideally maintain the primary files, an offsite cloud backup, and a separate local/offsite copy.

User chose an Anker cable organizer for their computer bag because they believe its compact, compartmented design will fit well. They may organize items by category (charging, audio, USB) and consider labels for similar cables.

User needs to open their laptop to clean the fans. They previously planned to buy a suitable precision screwdriver but have now overwritten that concern: they found a spare screwdriver from when they organized their computer desk and believe they are all set. They may still intend to upgrade the laptop’s RAM, but this has not been mentioned again.

User’s wireless mouse has been freezing. Their troubleshooting plan is to reset it using the manufacturer’s instructions first; if that does not help, they will update the mouse drivers from the manufacturer’s website and restart. If it remains unresolved, suggested follow-up includes checking/recharging the battery, testing a different USB port or receiver, reducing wireless interference, reconnecting Bluetooth if applicable, trying a spare mouse/receiver, or contacting the manufacturer.
